verdict.rationale: Natural-language prompting is Claude's core interaction model. The docs show users generating files by prompting "using natural language," building artifacts "by simply describing what you need," and delegating multi-step Cowork tasks, including recurring ones, by describing an outcome. Voice mode extends this to spoken commands, and the browser and computer-use features act on those instructions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands reliably drive the agentic surfaces (Cowork, computer use, browser), and voice mode is still beta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Prompt Claude using natural language to generate Excel spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, and PDF files that you can download and use immediately.
With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work
build tools, visualizations, and experiences by simply describing what you need.
Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.
Voice mode allows you to have complete spoken conversations with Claude.
Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms while you watch
